svg.text: Before: five things you run by hand in the right order. After: ONE object that runs them in dependency order, on a schedule,

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: retries on failure, and emails you if something breaks. This is the step that makes the project 'production', not just 'built'.

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif
Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 1. A schedule spends credits on every run. For the trial, run the job MANUALLY, or schedule it, capture a successful run for the

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: portfolio, then REMOVE the schedule. A daily job left running after you stop watching will quietly drain credits.

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 2. Retries default to 4. That is safe here because every task is idempotent — the pipelines use checkpoints and the Auto Loader

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: notebook tracks processed files — so a re-run never double-loads. Worth confirming before raising retries on a non-idempotent task.
